faq_h2: Alta Del Mar Homes: Common Questions

faq.q: How much do homes in Alta Del Mar cost?
faq.a: In the last 12 months, 3 single-family homes in Alta Del Mar sold between $4.21M and $5.1M, at a median of $4.5M. See the price-by-size cards and recent sales on this page for what each kind of home sold for.

faq.q: How many homes are in Alta Del Mar?
faq.a: Alta Del Mar has about 216 homes, built 2013 to 2016.

faq.q: What school area is Alta Del Mar in?
faq.a: Alta Del Mar is in the Sage Canyon Elementary attendance area (Del Mar Union School District). High school is Torrey Pines High (San Dieguito Union HSD), with Canyon Crest Academy and San Dieguito Academy available by lottery. School boundaries change, so confirm any address with the district before you buy.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell in Alta Del Mar?
faq.a: Over the last 12 months, the median Alta Del Mar home sold in 49 days on market. Well-priced homes often go under contract in the first week.
